arguments.value: The parties agree to jointly file required SEC reports under Sections 13 and 16 of the Exchange Act for each other, and to include this agreement as an exhibit to those filings. The agreement stays in effect until one party revokes it in a signed written notice to the others, and the revocation applies only to the party that gives notice.
